name: openbb_index_constituents
description:
Members of the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 or Dow Jones through the OpenBB Platform (obb.index.constituents, symbol sp500, nasdaq or dowjones).
Returns: {index, provider, count, constituents: [records with symbol, name, sector, sub-industry, date added]} or {index, error}.
Inputs (* required): index (sp500, nasdaq or dowjones; default sp500); provider (fmp; default fmp).
Same lists from FMP directly: fmp_sp500_constituents, fmp_nasdaq_constituents, fmp_dowjones_constituents. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"index": "dowjones"}
